source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The checked blocked-content test has existing assertion-message mismatches: the temporary file exists check says the file is not there; the assertion preserving the inaccessible URL says it is not in the content; and the assertion excluding the temporary file URL says it is still present. These are failure-state messages, not the expected conditions. A scoped correction would say the temporary image file should exist, the inaccessible URL should remain, and the temporary URL should be absent after conversion. These messages predate the helper-move change. This is static test-review evidence and does not claim the assertions fail at runtime or change the deliberate writing rule.
title: Describe the expected condition in blocked-content assertion messages
